title: Word Ladder
summary: Plan from both ends and meet in the middle.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Change COLD into WARM, changing one letter at a time, and each step must be a real word.
points: Change COLD into WARM, changing one letter at a time, and each step must be a real word.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Change one letter at a time and keep the rest.
Think of which letters you must change to reach the end.
points: Change one letter at a time and keep the rest.

steps.title: The method: Work from both ends
sentences: COLD to CORD, CORD to CARD, CARD to WARD, WARD to WARM.
That is four steps, each changing only one letter.
Try also from the other end to check it.
points: COLD to CORD, CORD to CARD, CARD to WARD, WARD to WARM.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: There can be more than one right route.
Planning from both ends saves time.

quiz.q: Which is a valid first step from CAT to DOG?
quiz.why: CAT to COT changes one letter. COG changes two.
